name: fmp_forex_quote
description:
Latest quote for one currency pair from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/fx as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (pair as six letters, e.g. EURUSD).
For pairs use fmp_forex_list; for history fmp_forex_historical; to convert an amount calc_currency_converter.
Example: {"symbol": "EURUSD"}
